interpretation: Native reproduces prior chosen stream; first-window frozen controls match native outputs, including pointer and memory, under existing FP32 gates.
Withheld updates and temporal aging are coupled. This does not isolate wrong-mask feedback as the sole cause.
Probe masks converge from212 in first window and344 in second; reported observations converge from212 and358 respectively. Equality of observations is not proof of internal tensor equality.
Both probe variants remain nonempty all40 first-window frames despite wrong identity. No ground-truth accuracy rate is calculated.
One retrospectively selected development clip, original CPU only; no iPhone, Core ML, speed, or held-out generalization claim.
decision: Reject blanket freezing or conditioning-only replacement; preserve production and frozen recovery policies.
nextDirection: First inspect how pinned upstream selects conditioning frames, then consider a separate controlled diagnostic using an additional earlier visually reviewed target frame as conditioning memory. Treat a manual anchor as an experimental upper bound, not an automatic identity solution; compare correct partial returns, wrong people and missed visible target together.
changes: Audit and HANDOFF only; no app, models, weights, exporter, numerical gates or recovery policies changed.
